title: Sprint G6 - aggregate next and aging signals
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 4). The killer view: bwrk global next fans the per-workspace next selection across every linked project - sourced from rollups, not live fan-out - and returns the single most important directive per project plus one overall, ranked by severity, subject priority, and age of obligation. Aging is the real PM signal: ready-rot (items sitting ready untouched), limbo age (verified-but-unclosed and needs_verification), and expired reservations, all derivable from event logs projects already write. No other tracker can render a needs-to-happen column honestly because no other trackers obligations derive from enforcement; this sprint is where that thesis pays off at portfolio level.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
